in_sanskrit.name: देवजय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Devajay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'jay' meaning 'victory'. It signifies the victory of the divine over the mundane and the triumph of righteousness over evil.
